COLLABORATION AT THE CORE OF OUR PRACTICE

A practical perspective,
backed by experience.

P S B & Associates LLP was established in 2013 by founding partners CA Pavan S. Toshniwal and CA Bharadwaj R. Mandhane, with CA Sagar S. Nikam serving as partner in our leadership team. Headquartered in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar with established branch offices in Pune and Hingoli, our firm unites rigorous technical discipline with responsive, partner-led attention to help businesses navigate statutory complexities.

The firm provides services to clients in India and abroad. Our team of chartered accountants and other professionals works under partner guidance across assurance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, tax planning, financial planning, company formation, business setup and financing.

Our practice serves clients in India and abroad, including Indian and multinational corporates, banking and financial institutions, startups, high-net-worth individuals, executives and expatriates. Our sector coverage also includes hospitals and healthcare organisations, maritime and transportation businesses, and builders and developers.

HOW WE WORK

Careful work. Clear communication.

Professional integrity

At the core of our work is an unwavering commitment to professional integrity. We believe that doing the right thing isn't just a policy—it's the foundation of every relationship we build. From transparent communication to delivering on our promises, we hold ourselves accountable to the highest ethical standards, ensuring you can always trust us to act in your best interest.

Partner-led attention

When you work with us, your matters are guided directly by experienced leadership. We believe in a hands-on approach where our partners are actively involved in your engagements from start to finish. Rather than navigating through layers of junior staff, you benefit from the immediate insights, strategic oversight, and dedicated expertise of our senior professionals.

Time-bound execution

We understand that your business operates on strict timelines, and so do we. Our approach to every engagement is rooted in proactive planning, clear milestones, and prompt delivery. We execute our strategy with precision and efficiency, ensuring that you receive high-quality results exactly when you need them, keeping your financial operations running seamlessly.
